precedence: These explicit overrides govern future work; v2 and completed evidence remain historical.

budget_overrides.S0: Actual ordinary GLC anchor at the explicitly selected delivery resolution and original timeline, frozen before semantic outputs; no longer automatically 1080p q32

budget_overrides.near_equal_pair: Retain v2 no-larger and <=2% reporting category; failure of matching does not relax either hard user cap. Explicit unmatched diagnostics require measured gap disclosure.

viewing: Default labeled full-frame and synchronized fish-region comparison. Do not imply the user must distinguish imperceptible variants in blind guessing. Report fallback or unchanged semantic input explicitly.
training: No automatic training; use measured mechanism evidence first
